  spread_draws(r_defensive_team[team,]) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = r_defensive_team, y = reorder(team, r_defensive_team))) +

       x = "Random Effect",
       y = "Team") +
  theme_minimal() +

# Improved player effects visualization
player_effects <- foul_binomial_model_vs_1 %>%
  spread_draws(r_primary_defender[primary_defender,]) %>%
  # Calculate summary statistics for each player
  group_by(primary_defender) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_effect = mean(r_primary_defender),
    lower_95 = quantile(r_primary_defender, 0.025),
    upper_95 = quantile(r_primary_defender, 0.975)
  ) %>%
  # Order players by mean effect
  arrange(mean_effect) %>%
  # Create a factor to maintain ordering in the plot
  mutate(primary_defender = factor(primary_defender, levels = primary_defender)) %>%
  # Create the plot
  ggplot(aes(x = mean_effect, y = primary_defender)) +
  # Add point estimate
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  # Add 95% credible intervals
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = lower_95, xmax = upper_95), height = 0) +
  # Add vertical line at 0
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  # Add labels
  labs(
    title = "Player-Level Defensive Effectiveness",
    subtitle = "Ordered by mean effect size (higher = better defense)",
    x = "Defensive Effect (log-odds)",
    y = "Player",
    caption = "Red line indicates average defensive effectiveness"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10)
  )

# Create a focused view of top and bottom performers
top_bottom_players <- foul_binomial_model_vs_1 %>%
  spread_draws(r_primary_defender[primary_defender,]) %>%
  group_by(primary_defender) %>%
  summarise(mean_effect = mean(r_primary_defender)) %>%
  arrange(mean_effect) %>%
  slice(c(1:10, (n()-9):n())) %>%  # Take top and bottom 10
  pull(primary_defender)

player_effects_focused <- foul_binomial_model_vs_1 %>%
  spread_draws(r_primary_defender[primary_defender,]) %>%
  filter(primary_defender %in% top_bottom_players) %>%
  group_by(primary_defender) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_effect = mean(r_primary_defender),
    lower_95 = quantile(r_primary_defender, 0.025),
    upper_95 = quantile(r_primary_defender, 0.975)
  ) %>%
  arrange(mean_effect) %>%
  mutate(primary_defender = factor(primary_defender, levels = primary_defender)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = mean_effect, y = primary_defender)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = lower_95, xmax = upper_95), height = 0) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  labs(
    title = "Top and Bottom 10 Defensive Players",
    subtitle = "Based on defensive effectiveness",
    x = "Defensive Effect (log-odds)",
    y = "Player"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10)
  )
